plainText:
----
 
(Japanese: The Competitive and the Stubborn Novelist) is a Pokémon manga written by Moriko Mori and illustrated by Cota Tomimura. It was published weekly on the official Project Piplup X (Twitter) account from August 25 to October 27, 2021. Each chapter is four pages long.

It was announced on August 24, 2021. It was planned and produced by wwwaap. 

==Characters==
Ryūnosuke (Japanese: Ryūnosuke). He is a novelist.
Kozue (Japanese: Kozue). She is Ryūnosuke's editor.
